d: How many days a week should you work out to build muscle — and is a 6-day workout plan in the gym actually better than training 3 days a week? We put over 200 lifters through a 10-week experiment comparing a 3-day vs 6-day push/pull/legs split, plus a third group that packed the full 6-day volume into three full-body workouts. The results reveal some important lessons about how often you should work out, how many times a week you should work out each muscle group, and when more training stops paying off.
